summary: Prevent streamed MEDIA HTML directives leaking as Telegram text
description: Reproduce and fix the Bertus Telegram regression where a valid local HTML MEDIA directive appears literally in the streamed text bubble instead of only as a native document attachment.
acceptance: A MEDIA directive split across streaming deltas never appears in any sent or edited text.
The completed response still reaches post-stream extraction for native document delivery.
Normal text containing MEDIA-like examples remains truthfully visible when no valid attachment directive exists.
